meta.name: golden-chat-single
meta.description: Use when testing the golden_chat_single golden build

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要验证黄金构建的聊天功能
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify the golden chat build

howto.what: 它把一份 Slack 聊天记录（golden_chat_single）作为参考资料装进 Claude，回答时可引用其中的对话、代码片段和分享链接。这份记录只有 1 条消息、1 位用户，频道为 #general。
howto.when: 当你想从 golden_chat_single 聊天记录里找讨论过的解决方案、代码片段或排障步骤时触发。

say.text: golden_chat_single 里 #general 那条消息说了什么？
say.note: Claude 查阅这份聊天记录后回答

say.text: 从这份聊天记录里找找有没有关于这个问题的讨论
say.note: 按记录内容作答，没有就说明

say.text: 把记录里分享过的链接和代码片段列出来
say.note: 按记录实际内容列出，可能为空

howto.what_en: It loads the golden_chat_single Slack export as reference material, so Claude can cite its conversations, code snippets and shared links when answering. The export holds just 1 message from 1 user in #general.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to look up solutions, code snippets or troubleshooting steps discussed in the golden_chat_single chat history.

say_en.text: What did the single #general message in golden_chat_single say?
say_en.note: Claude reads the chat record then answers

say_en.text: Search this chat history for any discussion of this issue
say_en.note: Answers from the record; says so if nothing found

say_en.text: List the links and code snippets shared in the record
say_en.note: Lists what is actually there; may be empty
